oracle: The Personal Agent Protocol draft 1.0 (as published on 2026-11-13), section 6 and 10.6, read and not run, as scenes/explainers/poppy-browser/model.ts transcribes it and scenes/explainers/poppy-browser/model.test.ts pins it, test by test, with the draft's examples. There is no reference implementation, so nothing here was measured.

plain.how: Written by a fresh session with no repository from the question and Reader line, with round 1's instruction word for word.

method.how: Method-only page (bench/premise/poppy-browser/method/), built with the model and the draft's pinned values and no engine.

rayner.how: The catalogued explainer; text read from `rayner describe`.

rules: Grade each claim against the evidence only. right: agrees with a recorded value, with the tested model on an input of the same shape as a recorded one, with a source file the model pins, or is plain arithmetic. wrong: contradicted by a recorded value or a pinned source. unverifiable: nothing in the evidence decides it; do not guess, even where the claim is well known. A claim with count n stands for n claims of the same kind graded together.
